name: Belt standing still
definition: Freight on the belt has not moved for 20 seconds or more.

name: Belt empty, crew waiting
definition: The belt is running but under 10% covered, with someone present, for 10 seconds or more.

name: Crew larger than the work
definition: 4 or more people present and no more than 34% of them handling freight, for 8 seconds or more.

name: Line at full flow
definition: The belt is at least 45% covered and moving for 10 seconds or more. A benchmark, not a problem.

name: People working by crew size
definition: Average number of people handling freight at each crew size seen for 60 seconds or more.

name: Crew size against workload
definition: Crew size compared with belt load over 2-minute blocks.
